note: Small, quiet Alberta Parks campground at the Shunda beaver-dam pond, about 5 km east of Nordegg just off Hwy 11, run by Westward Bound Campgrounds; dock and hand launch. The three vehicle sites are pull-ups around the day-use parking lot that the agency calls suitable for smaller trailers or truck campers, with no length posted; the other seven sites are walk-in tent sites. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (May 29, 2026) + tear sheet: C$24, first-come, season May 8 - Oct 3 (was approximate May 1 - Oct 31), only 3 vehicle sites (count 10 -> 3); 'suitable for smaller trailers or truck campers' (criteria flag); PIN ~760 m off at a log yard; old note's 'fits a 23-ft rig' line was read at that wrong pin and is dropped.
flags: CRITERIA (rig wording, singled out): the page says 'there are three pull-up sites surrounding the parking area, suitable for smaller trailers or truck campers' - no length stated. Not agency boilerplate (it describes this lot). No review from the last 3 years found in which the reviewer's own 23 ft+ rig fit: the newest Google reviews (2-6 years old) speak only of tenting, the pond and trails. On imagery the pull-ups sit round a small gravel lot (~40-50 m across), so a 23-ft Class C may fit in the lot but pads are not visible. Kept with a caveat in the note per the unclear-fit rule.

PIN (52.48522,-116.01177) = the page's directions point, but on imagery it is a log/timber yard in a clearing ~760 m south-east of the campground. The tear sheet puts the parking loop, pull-up sites 8-10 and the dock at the north-east end of Shunda Beaverdam pond, off the road beside Hwy 11; on imagery that lot and dock are at ~52.4914,-116.0167. Recommend moving the pin there. (Google's place point 52.489114,-116.0104708 is a third, generic point.)

OLD NOTE: '(open cleared loops on satellite fit a 23-ft rig)' was evidently read at the wrong pin (the log yard's cleared rows); dropped. 'bring own drinking water' dropped: the page lists no water source but says nothing about it.
SITE COUNT: stored 10 counted the 7 walk-in tent sites; only the 3 pull-up sites take a vehicle, so count 3.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The pull-up sites are on the north side of the parking loop toward the highway; the lot, washrooms and day-use area lie between them and the pond (~50-90 m). The pond is a beaver-dam pond (~400 m long on imagery, well over 5 acres).

PHONE stored 855-721-3975 matches the page 'Information: 1-855-721-3975'; Facility Operator: Westward Bound Campgrounds. SENIORS LINE PRESENT. WEBSITE answered 200 and is this campground. Google: 4.6 from 51 reviews.
